caseName: Federal Communications Commission v. Iowa Utilities Board
caseNameFull: Federal Communications Commission v. Iowa Utilities Board and AT&T Corp. v. Iowa Utilities Board

opinions.text:
C. A. 8th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and cases remanded for further consideration in light of AT&T Corp. v. Iowa Utilities Bd., ante, p. 366.

Justice O’Connor took no part in the consideration or decision of these cases.

Reported below. 135 F. 3d 535.
